findings.evidence: Executed at 238d26b + working tree: `bash .claude/tests/component/run.sh --filter <spec>` -> verify-review-discipline FAILED 7 pass/17 fail (134s); arbitration-acceptance FAILED 26/7 (134s); review-artifact-durability FAILED 29/12 (209s); worktree-approval-resolution FAILED 31/34 (299s); qa-gate FAILED 238/21 (1311s, all 21 in the P7-* family). findings.description: The design-satisfied migration covered only specs seeded through lib/fixture.sh seed_review_records (which now folds in seed_design_verdict) plus the two F1-shaped sites the fix round named. Five specs seed their records through SPEC-LOCAL helpers (p7_seed_review, run_cycle_approve, worktree's completion+approve helper, verify-review-discipline's inline seeding, arbitration's record_artifact path) and drive approve to expected SUCCESS with neither a design verdict nor --no-design, so DESIGN-SATISFIED-REFUSAL (unconditional by design) turns 91 assertions red across 5 specs. The fix round's own completion contract called 11B 'the migration's one other miss' and seed_design_verdict's header claims 'every spec driving approve to SUCCESS acquired this precondition too' — both claims are measured false. The phase's single uninterrupted component-tier acceptance pass fails as shipped. The refusal mechanism itself behaved correctly in every observed failure; this is unmigrated test seeding, not a gate defect.

findings.evidence: The F1-APPROVE-REFUSAL emit_block recovery text, step 3, prints: approve $CURRENT_TASK --no-review '...' --no-completion '...' 'manual re-run of the F1 approval' — two bypasses. The in-code F1 call at :3325-3328 now carries three (--no-design added by this fix round, ~130 lines above in the same function).
findings.description: The printed recovery recipe promises 'run the same approval by hand' but is no longer the same approval: on the ordinary doc-only task (no design phase) the hand-rerun refuses no_design_attempted where the automated call succeeds, so the recipe is structurally incapable of reproducing the F1 approval it names. Same class as the J21 option-1 recipe R1-F4 fixed at :2149-2159 in this same file — the sweep fixed the named recipe and missed the sibling. Below gz3 severity because the refusal envelope loudly names the --no-design remedy (one extra round-trip, no deadlock, no state damage) — hence medium, not high.
